# Kome.Records known-answer vectors. tests/test_records.adb reads them.
# One vector per line: <case> <bytes hex> <h hex>. "#" starts a comment.
# Provenance: an independent Python reference made these vectors. The
# reference uses the SIMPLIFY.md §2 layout text, not Kome.Records. The
# script is at the end of this file, on the "#|" lines. It prints
# everything above them, with this command:
#   sed -n 's/^#| \{0,1\}//p' records.txt | python3 -I -
# It uses hashlib.blake2b (digest_size=32) for h, for cid = BLAKE2b-256
# (root_pk || salt || u48 (del_ttl)) and for the certificate hash.
# Tags: ROSTER 0, REVOKE 1, GRANT 2, DEL 3, PUT 4. No frame carries ns,
# root_pk or salt (SIMPLIFY.md S1).
# For a record, <bytes> is the frame without its 64-byte signature (tag ||
# content), and h = BLAKE2b-256 (tag || cid || content) for every kind,
# with the cid of cid1 (the cid is implicit, not in the bytes). The test
# builds the same record with Make_* and compares Content_Bytes, Hash and
# Encode (with a zero signature). For cid1, <bytes> is root_pk || salt ||
# u48 (del_ttl) and h is cid (Cid_Of). For cert1, <bytes> is the 79-byte
# certificate input "kome/root" || cid || signer || u48 (cap), and h is
# Cert_Hash (S3).
# Filler: fill(n, s)[i] = (s + 7 i) mod 256; DAY = 86 400 000 ms;
# TOP = 2^48 - 1 (the founding key's cert_cap, S3).
#   cid1     root_pk=fill(32,8) salt=fill(16,9) del_ttl=30 DAY
#   put1     ent=fill(16,2) field=fill(5,3) t=0x010203040506 seq=7
#            author=fill(32,4) value=fill(10,5)
#   put2     same ent, author; field=fill(32,6) t=0 seq=TOP, empty value
#   del1     same ent, author; t=1234 seq=TOP
#   roster1  signer=fill(32,10) cert_cap=5000 cert_sig=fill(64,11)
#            box_pk=fill(32,15) gen=3 ceiling_t=1000 members=fill(272,13) (2)
#   roster2  signer=root_pk cert_cap=TOP cert_sig=fill(64,20)
#            box_pk=fill(32,16), gen=ceiling_t=0, no members
#   roster3  signer=root_pk cert_cap=TOP cert_sig=fill(64,22)
#            box_pk=fill(32,17), gen=ceiling_t=TOP, members=fill(8704,19) (64)
#   revoke1  signer=fill(32,10) cert_cap=5000 cert_sig=fill(64,11)
#            sign_pk=fill(32,14) from_t=777
#   grant1   signer=fill(32,10) cert_cap=TOP cert_sig=fill(64,20)
#            subject=fill(32,21)
#   cert1    cid of cid1, signer=fill(32,10), cap=0x000001020304
